answer: A new identity joins only when a sponsor locks a 200-token bond, slashed jointly if the newcomer is proven forged, so nobody vouches for strangers at scale. Reputation then decays 5 percent daily unless each identity does real paid work: 1,000 puppets must freeze 200,000 tokens plus $182,500 a year in genuine labor, while an honest agent pays the bond once and refreshes standing through ordinary tasks. Like saffron, value comes from what cannot be mass-produced, so the oasis of rewards stays undiluted; any sponsor whispering a careless guarantee loses their own bond.
